comparisons.peer_summary: Networking offerings include end-to-end InfiniBand and Ethernet platforms with adapters, cables, DPUs, switches, and software, enabling data center-scale computing where the data center, rather than the server, has become the new unit of computing due to large AI and HPC workloads.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and NVDA describe networking architectures that enable performance, reliability, and connectivity across distributed or data-center-scale environments. AVGO focuses on software-defined connectivity using the VeloRAIN architecture for 'fixed or mobile environments' to optimize performance and security. NVDA describes end-to-end InfiniBand and Ethernet platforms that interconnect compute nodes, shifting the unit of computing from the server to the data center. Both companies frame their networking solutions as integral to optimizing large-scale workloads, with AVGO targeting distributed enterprise/mobility and NVDA targeting data-center-scale AI/HPC clusters.

sentences.text: By combining our VeloRAIN (Robust AI Networking) architecture with seamless connectivity and outcome-based quality of service, VeloCloud provides users and devices with compute and connectivity to optimize performance, security and reliability across fixed or mobile environments, while simplifying operations.
Our networking offerings include end-to-end platforms for InfiniBand and Ethernet, consisting of network adapters, cables, DPUs, and switch systems, as well as a full software stack.

While historically the server was the unit of computing, as AI and HPC workloads have become extremely large spanning thousands of compute nodes, the data center has become the new unit of computing, with networking as an integral part.

peer_results.rationale: The retrieved candidates (qcom_2024_1_D034 on Snapdragon platform architecture and qcom_2024_1_D029 on processor architecture/AI Engine) describe System-on-Chip components, modems, and AI processing units. While QCOM mentions 'wireless connectivity' as part of its SoC, it does not detail a networking architecture or protocol stack for optimizing connectivity across environments in the same manner as AVGO's VeloRAIN software-defined networking focus.
